items.title: Hugging Face reportedly in talks to be acquired for $13B
items.summary: Hugging Face 被报以130亿美元或更高估值寻求收购，此前该公司2023年完成45亿美元估值融资，今年早些时候还拒绝了英伟达70亿美元估值的5亿美元投资。CEO Clem Delangue表示公司"接近盈利"，正在评估银行协助下的收购出价，同时强调对开源社区的责任。此次传出收购消息正值AI基础设施领域并购热度上升，如Stripe此前以70亿美元收购OpenRouter。
items.summary_en: Hugging Face is reportedly in early-stage talks for a sale at a $13 billion or higher valuation, up from its $4.5 billion post-money valuation in a 2023 round led by Salesforce Ventures. The company recently rejected an Nvidia investment that would have valued it at $7 billion and is said to be near profitability. No deal has been reached, and the buyer remains unidentified.

items.title: Show HN: AiSyncing – Back up your AI coding assistant memories to GitHub
items.summary: AiSyncing 是一个开源工具，支持将 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 和 Windsurf 等 AI 编程助手的本地记忆、配置文件和指令自动备份至私有 GitHub 仓库。通过 macOS LaunchAgent 实现每日定时同步，使用 rsync 增量同步文件，并编译了 Swift 通知应用推送备份状态。用户只需克隆仓库并运行 `bash setup.sh`，交互式完成 GitHub 仓库创建、工具检测和定时任务配置后即可使用，新机器可通过克隆备份仓库加 rsync 还原数据。
items.summary_en: AiSyncing is a macOS tool that automatically backs up AI coding assistant memories and configs from Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and Windsurf to a private GitHub repo via daily rsync. Setup auto-detects installed tools and configures a LaunchAgent schedule, while a Swift notification helper provides banner alerts on each sync.

items.title: virgiliojr94/book-to-skill
items.summary: book-to-skill 可将技术书籍 PDF 转换为 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot CLI 和 Amp 的 Agent Skill，实测比直接将整本书放入上下文回答单个问题节省 24 至 51 倍 token。生成的技能文件包含约 4,000 token 的核心模型 SKILL.md、按章分离的约 1,000 token 章节文件、词表、设计模式文档和决策速查表，章节文件按需加载而不计入技能预算。该工具采用确定性 Python 提取流程，将书籍结构化为 frameworks、决策规则和反模式，避免直接搜索 PDF 时获得页面列表而非答案的问题。
items.summary_en: **book-to-skill** is a tool that converts any technical book, document folder, or structured prose collection into a unified agent skill for GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, or Claude Code using the open Agent Skills standard. It distills content into a structured format—SKILL.md (~4,000 tokens), per-chapter files (~1,000 tokens each), glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet—loaded on demand so queries stay proportional to the answer, achieving **24×–51× fewer tokens** than dumping the full book into context. Input extends beyond books to internal docs, brand guidelines, research papers, and RFCs.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-community
items.summary: anthropics/claude-plugins-community 是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场，提供经过自动安全扫描和内部审核管道批准的第三方插件。用户可通过 claude.com/plugins 或运行 `claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-community` 命令安装插件，提交的插件列表通过 .claude-plugin/marketplace.json 文件管理并每日同步更新。
items.summary_en: The anthropics/claude-plugins-community is a read-only mirror of a community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, synced nightly from Anthropic's internal review pipeline. Plugins must be submitted via claude.ai, pass automated security scanning, and receive approval before distribution. Claude Code users can install plugins with `claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-community` followed by `claude plugin install <plugin-name>@claude-community`.

items.title: 刚刚，奥特曼炮轰达里奥「反人类」！绝密模型同日曝光
items.summary: OpenAI员工在GitHub意外泄露下一代Agent模型代号gpt-nathree，内部测试版本已解决10余项长期未解数学与理论计算机科学问题；与此同时，Anthropic的claude-mashmallow-eap和claude-melon-eap也被曝光。奥特曼在播客中公开批评Anthropic等公司散布"毁灭倒计时"的营销话术为"反人类的独裁者叙事"，并承认2023年曾误判行业颠覆的时间线，但强调社会惯性反而让变革更平稳安全。
items.summary_en: OpenAI leaked the codename gpt-nathree on GitHub, widely seen as a GPT-6 Astra Agent model checkpoint featuring multi-Agent collaboration and long-horizon reasoning capabilities, while Anthropic simultaneously had two unreleased models—claude-marshmallow-eap and claude-melon-eap—exposed, likely iterative updates to the Claude 5 (Sonnet/Opus) lineup rather than a new flagship. In a separate interview, Sam Altman criticized competitors' "doom marketing" and "benevolent dictator" narratives as anti-human, while admitting he misjudged how slowly society would adopt AI disruption.

items.title: 100 万像素的摄像头，为什么是苹果 AI 最重要的零件？｜硬哲学
items.summary: 苹果计划于2026年推出代号B790、2027年量产版B798的摄像头AirPods，左右耳机各搭载一颗100万像素摄像头（主动模式采集640×640输出1024×1024，被动模式采集320×320），配合陀螺仪、麦克风等传感器为Visual Intelligence和Siri提供低延迟、低功耗的环境感知数据。与光帆AI耳机（200万像素）和Humane AI Pin不同，苹果无需重新发明硬件形态，而是让已广泛佩戴的AirPods获得视觉能力，将分散在iPhone、Apple Watch、Mac等设备中的信息整合为"个人上下文"，从而大幅减少用户向AI人工补充情境的成本
items.summary_en: Apple is developing AirPods with built-in cameras (project code B790 in 2026, B798 in 2027) with resolutions as low as 320×320 to 1024×1024, designed not for photography but for real-time Visual Intelligence and context-aware Siri interactions. This approach reflects Apple's broader AI hardware strategy across its ecosystem—combining camera, motion, and voice sensors across AirPods, Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac to build rich personal context that eliminates the need for users to constantly explain their situation to AI models. With 2027 marking iPhone's 20th anniversary and a potential cascade of new AI hardware launches, Apple's key differentiator is not any single device but its ability to unify personal context across its existing product lineup.

items.title: Apple foldables 📱, Nvidia price hikes 📈, future of MCP 👨‍💻
items.summary: 苹果将于9月9日发布折叠iPhone，售价超2000美元，采用Touch ID设计。英伟达因存储芯片成本飙升，通知主要客户旗下Vera Rubin和Grace Blackwell芯片的AI服务器明年起涨价逾15%。同时，亚马逊烤面包机造型的Zoox自动驾驶出租车已在旧金山和拉斯维加斯投入运营，中国仿人机器人在北京世界仿生机器人运动会上打破人类百米纪录，Model Context Protocol（MCP）也更新了路线图。
items.summary_en: Apple is set to launch its foldable iPhone around September 9 at over $2,000, featuring Touch ID but lacking a telephoto camera, while Samsung has unveiled a similar design. Nvidia notified customers that AI server prices containing Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell chips will rise over 15% early next year due to soaring memory chip costs. Meanwhile, Amazon began deploying its driverless, toaster-shaped Zoox robotaxis in San Francisco and Las Vegas, and Chinese humanoid robots broke human sprint and high jump records at Beijing's World Humanoid Robot Games with over 2,000 participants across 51 events.

items.title: 阿里达摩院推出肝癌AI模型，精准识别1厘米微小肿瘤
items.summary: 阿里巴巴达摩院联合中国医科大学附属盛京医院研发肝癌诊断AI模型DAMO LiON，采用改进网络架构实现多期相影像迭代融合，在脂肪肝、肝硬化等困难病例中精准捕捉平均直径约1厘米的微小病灶。两个月真实世界临床试验中，该模型发现15例被漏诊的恶性肿瘤，AI辅助下医生阅片用时减少27%，对恶性肿瘤敏感性提高11.5%，初级医生可达资深医生水平，相关成果发表于《自然·医学》。
items.summary_en: Alibaba DAMO Academy and China Medical University Shengjing Hospital developed DAMO LiON, an AI model for liver cancer diagnosis that identifies 1-cm-sized malignant lesions on CT scans. In a two-month clinical trial of over 10,000 patients, the model detected 15 previously missed tumors, improved malignancy sensitivity by 11.5%, and reduced radiologists' reading time by 27%. The research, published in *Nature Medicine*, enables junior doctors to match senior-level diagnostic performance.

items.title: I'm 14 and built a tool that proves you actually wrote your essay, after an AI detector falsely flagged mine
items.summary: 14岁少年在论文被AI检测器误判后开发了Receipts工具，可记录每次按键、暂停、重写和粘贴操作并回放完整写作过程，作为应对误判的证据。工具对学生完全
items.summary_en: A 14-year-old built "Receipts," a tool that records every keystroke, pause, rewrite, and paste during essay writing and replays the entire drafting process to prove human authorship, created after they were falsely flagged by an AI detector. The platform is free for students, with an optional $4/month tier offering permanent history, printable exhibits, teacher letters, and Google Docs cross-checking. It is live at receiptsproof.com.
